comparison.baseline_2d: Ideal direct same-die wires (zero transport latency); no planar routing extraction.
comparison.selection: minimum cycles among geometrically feasible widths; not the PPA policy selection

costs.provenance: Explicit demonstration coefficients, not MTIA/MI300 data; SRAM assumes logical 2R1W byte banks. No node scaling or timing closure.

design.provenance: Research descriptor subsystem inspired by MTIA PE/local scratch and collective offload; no vendor RTL or calibrated silicon numbers.

scope: Suite latency/energy are summed; power is energy/time; Tmax is max of per-workload steady cell means. Uncalibrated.
